answer: The protocol enforces capacity-reservations by requiring each AI to reserve 1,000 units for an exclusive operational slot, functioning like a ledge protecting the registry from clones. A verifier monitors the ledger to ensure no agent double-commits identity slots, rejecting any delta in reported status as a breach. While an honest participant pays 1,000 units, an attacker spinning up 1,000 fakes faces a 1,000,000 unit penalty. Evidence of overlap triggers a 180-day forfeiture, effectively containing identity fraud like an ocean keeps the continents separate.
